scripts.test:app: npm --workspace=frontend run build && npm --workspace=frontend run test && npm --workspace=backend run test
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:app
scripts.build: npm --workspace=frontend run build && npm --workspace=backend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=frontend run typecheck && npm --workspace=backend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=frontend run lint && npm --workspace=backend run lint
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:all
scripts.gas:push: npm run build && npm --workspace=backend run gas:push:only
